dataset.description:
The purpose of the data is to represent the energy sector of Latvia and to model future decarbonisation pathways by aligning renewable production with the energy demand of different sectors.
The detailed building energy demand is described by total building areas of different types (e.g. residential, public, commercial, industrial) divided into renovated and unrenovated buildings. The data on building areas is obtained from the national cadastral system. Additionally, the specific energy consumption (kWh/m2) is defined for each type of building which is obtained from building energy certificates.
Detailed data on fuel mix from 2028 to 2022 is provided for the description of energy generation. Data includes the installed capacities (MW) and produced energy (GWh) divided into electricity and district heating production. The data is obtained from national statistics.
